tools.name: preview_document
tools.description: Free: extract page 1 of a PDF (auto-detects invoice/receipt/PO/W-9/bank statement) with per-field confidence.

tools.name: extract_document
tools.description: Full extraction of all pages. Costs $0.03 USDC (x402).

tools.name: spread_bank_statement
tools.description: Bank statement → every transaction + underwriting metrics (ADB, NSF, MCA/loan positions, revenue trend, DSCR inputs, tamper flags). Costs $0.40 USDC (x402).

tools.name: pdf_to_text
tools.description: PDF to plain text or markdown, page by page (text-layer PDFs only). Costs $0.0025 USDC (x402).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "pdf_to_text" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "PDF to plain text or markdown, page by page, OCR for scanned pages. Costs $0.0025 USDC (x402)." → after: "PDF to plain text or markdown, page by page (text-layer PDFs only). Costs $0.0025 USDC (x402)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "ocr_document" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
